items.s: Bitcoin Magazine SEC Charges Two Companies in $130 Million Crypto Trading Scheme The SEC has charged two companies with defrauding investors of over $130 million through a crypto Ponzi-like scheme.

items.h: Strategy’s preferred-stock fix sets up renewed bitcoin buying, analysts say
items.s: Strategy fell after Q3 earnings, but StoneX & TD Cowen kept buy ratings, citing $4.83B cash reserve and more stable STRC preferred structure.

items.h: Tyler Evans: Bitcoin ETF Flows Flipped From “Highly Negative” to “Strong Accumulation”
items.s: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Tyler Evans: Bitcoin ETF Flows Flipped From “Highly Negative” to “Strong Accumulation” Tyler Evans breaks down Bitcoin's post-bear setup: Fed policy, bond yields, surging ETF accumulation, and why U.S. midterms are pivotal heading into 2027.

items.h: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
items.s: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?

items.h: Doomberg: US Treasury Sanctions are “Wildly Bullish” for Bitcoin & Gold
items.s: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Doomberg: US Treasury Sanctions are “Wildly Bullish” for Bitcoin & Gold U.S. pressure to hold Treasuries forces central banks to sell what they can, says Doomberg, setting up a wildly bullish long-term case for gold and Bitcoin.

items.h: Alex Thorn: 50-Week Signal Says Bitcoin’s Bottom is In
items.s: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Alex Thorn: 50-Week Signal Says Bitcoin’s Bottom is In Galaxy's Alex Thorn calls the Bitcoin bottom, pointing to the 50-week moving average reclaim, resilience at $80K, and why being long is now contrarian.

items.h: Alexandre Laizet on The French Debt Crisis: “Europe is in Need of Bitcoin”
items.s: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Alexandre Laizet on The French Debt Crisis: “Europe is in Need of Bitcoin” France hits 120% debt-to-GDP. Capital B's Alexandre Laizet explains why misspent debt and currency debasement make the case for a Bitcoin treasury strategy.

items.h: Israel Extradites Alleged Nomad Bridge Exploiter to US Over $2.8M Theft: Report
items.s: Israel's Supreme Court ruled that exploiting a coding flaw can count as computer intrusion, even when the software allowed the transaction.

items.h: Binance says it has $6.34 billion ready to cover hack losses
items.s: Binance has allocated $6.34 billion to cover hack losses, while industry partners have frozen another $3 billion in affected assets.

items.h: Zcash grants group offers $124M compromise as governance backlash grows
items.s: Zcash Community Grants proposed redirecting about $124 million in existing and future funding toward mining rewards, but critics say the plan fails to address governance and accountability concerns.

items.h: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
items.s: Security experts said attackers could have drained Binance’s wallets without EIP-7702, but the Ethereum upgrade may have helped bypass withdrawal safeguards.

items.h: Binance hacker’s Bitcoin haul tops Coinbase’s corporate treasury
items.s: The attackers held 18,270 BTC early Friday, topping Coinbase’s reported corporate holdings, and an Ether stash exceeding 500,000 ETH.
